tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Hamilton in dimension three (Theorem 35.35)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0325 1. ch35:35.35\group Alternative Stability Methods

If a closed simply-connected $3$-manifold has positive Ricci curvature, its volume-normalized Ricci flow converges to a unique metric of constant positive curvature.
